lines.text: You'll tell people 'it's supposed to rain' like you have sources.
Tomorrow the rain brings out the snails. Finally, someone you can keep up with.
Or skip it. You could use a rinse.
Tomorrow kids will jump in every puddle you tiptoe around. You used to be fun.
There goes tomorrow's run. Not that it was going anywhere.
Don't worry, it won't rain on your parade. You'd need a parade.
If you have a better face, bring that too.
Cold hands, warm heart, they say. Tomorrow you'll at least have the hands.
Tomorrow your nose will probably run. The rest of you, as usual, won't.
You'll get cold feet tomorrow. The literal kind, for a change.
You're always cold. Tomorrow you'll finally have a reason.
You'll rub your hands together like a cartoon villain tomorrow. It suits you.
Shame it has to be one of yours.
Finally, a forecast that matches your wardrobe.
No costume changes, I'm afraid. Your public will cope.
Ideally not the one you've got on now.
